findings.message: No permissions are set for the workflow or any of its jobs, so the GITHUB_TOKEN gets the repository default, which may allow writes.
This actions/checkout step keeps the GITHUB_TOKEN in .git/config for every later step because persist-credentials is not set to false.
Action actions/checkout@v4 is not pinned to a full commit SHA, so the code behind that ref can still change.
